newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Sparks raises Argentine wheat crop to 15.1 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Sparks raises Argentine wheat crop to 15.1 mln T.

text.p: U.S. consultancy Sparks has raised its estimate of 1996/97 Argentine wheat output to 15.1 million tonnes from 14.25 million tonnes, Marcelo Taussik, Vice-president of of Sparks America del Sur Inc. said Monday.

Sparks believes Argentine wheat exports will rise to 9.6 million tonnes this season from 4.45 million tonnes in 1995/96, he told Reuters at a meeting of the Latin America Millers Association (ALIM) in the Paraguayan capital.
"The weather has been adequate, lots of rain, and together with a big increase in fertilization it really makes a difference," Taussik said.

Sparks estimates that Argentina's stock of wheat will rise to 766,000 tonnes by the end of the 1996/97 season from 146,000 tonnes at the beginning of this season. Wheat production will be up from 9.3 million tonnes last season.
